review_description: Salt Solar was chosen after receiving quotes from 3 suppliers. One supplier had to be prompted to supply a quote a week after the initial request.  The 3 quotes were close and that provided a good indication of "fair value" for the various systems. Salt Solar were quick in the initial job query reply and sounded professional. Being a "local" supplier and the offer of a free " Hot water timer and installation" placed Salt Solar ahead of the others. The installation was within 4 weeks of the deposit and was conducted efficiently. The invoice was paid within a week of receipt. Salt responded quickly to a request to increase the hot water recharging settings on the "rental" property.  However, the final documentation and link to the "smart" meter was still pending 3 weeks after installation.Thankyou- Solar Quotes for the guidance re panel quality and prices as well as a list of nearby "reliable" suppliers. It is too early to judge the overall quality and performance of the system- however so far so good. I would still recommend Salt

Ian from SALT Solar was very thorough going through the options and financial details such as savings etc. Other companies did not go to this level of detail. Communication was good throughout the process and the installers finished within one day and cleaned up very well afterwards. Very happy with the system.

We chose SALT Solar for a major upgrade to our existing solar system. After speaking to Jason and receiving a full written proposal we went with SALT.  Jason is an owner of the company and knows his solar back to front. The quote was very comprehensive and provided several suitable options and cost benefit alternatives. We felt SALT would be the best option for us. The installation team were excellent to deal with and we had complete confidence in Nathan, Mitch and the rest of the team. Very respectful around our property and polite enthusiastic young guys. The system was up and running in a day and meets all our expectations. As I learn how it performs Jason has been happy to answer all my questions. We also have the Catch relay installed and solar is now heating our water. Brilliant.

Troy, The Technician from Salt Solar attended to my Villa #11. PLR Cooroy-Noosa.The issue was the loss of communication between the Shine App and the Growatt Inverter which occurred as a result of a new and replacement Modem / Router.With all thanks going to Troy for his comprehensive knowledge of the Inverter installation as well as his knowledge of Network Technology was clearly displayed. As a result the communication breakdown was rectified.and the link between the Solar Panel array, the Inverter and the Shine App was restored.Manty thanks.Tony PortelliOwner / Occupier, Villa #11

Salt Solar live up to their many good reviews. They came up with a full plan including the financial details like the years until the new system pays itself off. The initial proposal was very detailed and really helped me make the decision about what size system to go with, they didn't push to upsell me. I love that they are local and have been in business for many years. I felt that I could trust them to do a good install.On the install day the guys were friendly and efficient, turned up on time, and let us know roughly how long it would take. They did a very clean install, and helped get me started on the inverter and the app to monitor it, and answered any questions I had. Shout out to them for installing on a pretty hot day and putting up with my VERY hot roof space. In my opinion I couldn't have asked for more, they were excellent.

We have had the pleasure of working with Tony in configuring our system which took some time as we have only recently moved into our new property and had no record of electric consumption. Tony was always responsive to our multiple requests for various configurations and having installed our previous solar system we had every confidence in his approach to our needs.Installation was a breeze and took less than a day. Great install team, very professional, knowledgeable providing a clean install.Customer service is a strong point for Salt. Fair prices. Would recommend them unequivocally.Currently waiting to be connected to solar meter.

My brother recommended Salt Solar.  I am so grateful for the seamless process.  I too would have no hesitation in recommending Tony and his team on the Sunshine Coast.   Our installer, Thomas, was prompt, respectful and knowledgeable.

I am new to the area and did my due diligence before deciding on Salt Solar. I am very pleased to say they did not disappoint. Tony came to see the job before the quote was given and when I decided to give them the job, they completed their work in a timely, professional manner. I would not hesitate in recommending them to anyone.

Quoting process very good. I was replacing a 10 year old 3.2 system with a 6.6 System.Tony was punctual of day of quote. His advice was excellent & his communication & quote was received the same day he visited my home. Updates were provided prior to installation.Day of installation the team of three ( Mitch, Joe ) led by John were punctual.Their work was meticulous. Very friendly, polite. John provided additional advice to my queries.On installation, John not only connected system to my wifi, showed me how to operate.( All old system panels, railings & inverter were taken from site )

Following obtaining quotes from another reputable company, we decided to obtain quotes from a local contractor. We are certainly pleased we did so. Tony and his team are totally professional and have excellent customer experience skills. All of our questions were answered fully and in a manner that we could understand. We would recommend Salt Solar without any hesitation.

Tony is not a salesman selling a product. He is an experienced Solar Installer who came around, inspected our property' quietly and expertly outlined his product and answered all question with his deep found knowledge. He was not pushy and I had total experience in having him install our solar system. I did have 5 other companies quote for my solar system and Salt Solar stood out as the one we would use. The installers were excellent, a team that worked together, were fastidious in their workmanship and very professional. Our solar system is up and running and I am very happy with the final result. Happy to recommend Tony and Salt Solar.

On the day of the install, John & his team were very efficient and professional. Overall, we felt that we had definitely made the right choice, and would be happy to recommend Salt to our friends if the need arises.

Initial contact thru design and quote, then redesign and quote at our request was great. Very professional.Installation team are a great young team, very efficient and tidy. Our panels were upgraded by Salt Solar at no extra cost.Highly recommend this business, very well run with good competent people.

SALT Solar recently installed a 6.6kwH system for us.Tony was quick to respond and attend to quote.He explained options in simple terms and was great with follow up questions while we were deciding between quotes.On the installation day the tradies that did the job were prompt, friendly and efficient. They assisted with setting up the Sungrow app and left the property spotless.Highly Recommend.

The quoting process was mostly an informal  no sales pressure discussion. I was given the opportunity to discuss the advantages of two options available i.e. installation of additional panels or replace the existing array completely. My decision was in favour of a complete replacement of the existing array. I was in awe of the cost coming in well to suit my budget. An additional very small cost was incurred later when I elected to have the Inverter located next to the existing Electrical Switchboard and not inside the house/garage.A second surprise came with the comprehensive report / quotation document. This document contained over 14 pages of details of the installation, aerial photographs, financial advantages and predictions of financial gains and savings.I was particularly impressed with the men during installation. Not only did they respect my position in which they answered a number of questions concerning the process but also were protective to damage to my property and the proximity of the surrounding properties.  This also involved consideration avoiding blocking off access to passing vehicles. On completion the area was completely cleared of any materials and / or equipment. The whole installation was performed with great care minimal noise. The differing installation of the Inverter was outstanding and was indeed beyond my expectations.On completion Salt Solar had arranged notice to Energex and obtained all prerequisites to connection to the grid. I was particularly pleased when I was given tuition and access to software that put me in the position with my iPhone to monitor the daily kWhAlthough my experience is minimal in this area, I think it would be very difficult to match the professionalism and efficiency of Salt Solar its staff and the owner Tony.

Noosa’s Salt Solar don’t need former Australian cricket captains to sell their services.They have a team of specialists who helped us decide on the system we wanted right through to the installation and clean-up.Just a few hours after we emailed them for a quote last Monday, Salt’s Tony Vitagliano was at our home advising on a new system. He worked out a more-than-competitive quote and promised installation within two weeks.A couple of days later Tony called and said his team could do the installation a week earlier.His team of John, Mitch and Joe arrived and started work. They explained what they were going to do and got on with things.During the day they were polite and informative. When the job was done, they cleaned up, hooked up the system to the grid and showed us how the system worked.Now it’s up to the sun. Thanks Salt.

The solar system’s itself can be /is very confusing .But the sales person (Tony) we had from salt solar made it easier to understand.The installation was great. The installers were tidy, on time, polite , friendly, informative and very helpful.The system was all connected and ready to go.

Absolutely delighted with the service provided by Tony and his team who replaced our dated existing solar system with something much more contemporary. From initial consultation to completion of the installation, this was a class performance. We were provided with a range of suitable options, sound advice and relevant information - and the space to make the decision that best suited us. The professional installation team communicated effectively and  unobtrusively. The icing on the cake is the knowledge that our old system will be repurposed to supply energy to a village in either Fiji or South Africa.

The team at SALT Solar were excellent from the initial discussion of options to the final install. Tony followed up to ensure the work was completed to my satisfaction and the on the ground team was lead well by John.

Tony was the ultimate professional. With no previous experience of solar installation we felt confident that the advice provided was right for us. The work was carried out promptly, the installers arrived on the dot and worked solidly the whole time they were here (despite the rain on day one). They were polite and friendly, they even played (softly) our kind of music.

I initially contacted Tony to compare solar quotes I had received from other businesses and he was more than happy to discuss the similarities and differences between them including how they operate and making sure it suited my needs. John, Joe and Mitch came out on install day and were on time, polite, friendly and professional. The intended spot for the inverter wasn’t suitable and I proposed a position outside, but John found an alternative position out of sight despite the extra work involved so that the system wouldn’t detract from the look of our house! The system looks like it was installed when the house was put up and my garage was actually cleaner when the team left than before they started! Thanks Tony and a big thanks to John, Joe and Mitch - it was good to see some trades still take pride in their workmanship!

This is the second home that I have installed Solar from Salt solar in.I chose Tony again because of his prompt professional service and competitive pricing, and because of his local presence. He has made the entire installation process seamless.The actual installation was very professionally done by John with very minimal disruption.I have absolutely no hesitation in recommending Salt solar for solar installation.

Salt Solar made the whole process very easy from start to finish. Tony and his team helped us immensely and walked us through the whole process. The communication from all of the team has been exceptional - couldn’t fault it. John and the installation team were on time, informative and took the time to describe and discuss the installation process.Overall, the Salt Solar team went out of their way to be informative and helpful and we would thoroughly recommend them.
